title: Keep main-health publication inside the validation fence
objective: Repair the live Swarm control regression where sync-main-health publishes state-digest-participating health files without publishing a matching validation marker, causing every subsequent product PR ownership check to fail closed until an unrelated control push regenerates the marker.
acceptance: sync-main-health cannot publish health state that makes the live validation marker stale
health publication remains CAS-fenced to the exact materialized control snapshot
a valid product PR receives explicit PASS immediately after a main-health publication without requiring an unrelated control push
stale health/projection writers still fail closed under concurrent control activity
control deterministic/adversarial tests and canonical CI remain green
notes: Emergency red-control prerequisite created from observed PR #289 ownership failure after main-health publication. This is a narrow continuation of the completed #290/#291 recovery, not a new product feature.
